universe.selection: common universe from the audited historical Price Action dataset when raw source is reacquired
universe.mapping: canonical symbol equals validated native MT5 export symbol; broker aliases must be recorded before replay

timeframes.timestamps: UTC candle-open timestamps; candle close is open plus timeframe duration
timeframes.htf_rule: H1 swings and levels are usable only after the strict left/right confirmation closes

causal_protocol.prior_move: strict monotonic completed M15 closes over prior_move_bars
causal_protocol.entry: the exact next M15 candle is identified by open_timestamp equal to pattern completion close_timestamp; later observations are delayed reconstruction/cancellation only
causal_protocol.entry_gap: cancel when adverse next-open displacement exceeds entry_gap_cancel_ticks
causal_protocol.target: nearest known opposing H1 level at pattern cutoff
causal_protocol.structural_zone: candle/pattern high-low interval must intersect [level-tolerance, level+tolerance] and the final pattern close must reject directionally from the level; wholly beyond the zone is invalid
causal_protocol.pattern_scope: engulfing uses both candles, star uses all three candles, pin-bar uses its single candle; stop uses the full pattern high/low
causal_protocol.engulfing_boundary: strict penetration: current open is strictly beyond prior close and current close strictly beyond prior open; equality is rejected for this new definition
causal_protocol.outcome: research proposal and paper-entry observations only; no outcome resolver is invoked without a compatible frozen outcome protocol
causal_protocol.costs: not applied to detector proposals; any later outcome report must declare spread, commission, and slippage assumptions

definitions.pattern: strict opposing body engulfing with close beyond prior body extreme
three-candle star; minimum first/third bodies; bounded middle body; third candle recovers the frozen fraction; exchange gap optional and explicitly false
directional rejection candle with minimum range, wick/body ratio, opposite-wick cap, and close-location threshold; zero-body and zero-range rejected

reporting.performance_claims: forbidden until raw dataset is reacquired, replayed, and outcome semantics are proven compatible
